title: An acknowledgement's queued continuation is not rebuilt after a failure or host restart, so owed next-turn work stays unwoken
outcome: An acknowledgement's queued continuation is not rebuilt after a failure or host restart, so owed next-turn work stays unwoken
acceptance: A queued continuation owed after a receipt acknowledgement (one without noContinuation) survives a runtime failure and a host restart: after recovery the session receives that continuation wake once, or the host records a visible typed lost-continuation state; it is never silently dropped. A behavioural test covers restart and failure, and a noContinuation acknowledgement still suppresses it.
The change has a clean review pair and passes the full gate.
